2.stem_plain: Rani is well-known ________ her expertise in growing orchids.

3.stem_plain: "Won't Alice be excited when she ________ that she's representing the class for the speech competition?" Ben asked.

4.stem_plain: Mother objected to ________ the bag for Sarah as it was too expensive.

5.stem_plain: Tina made ________ progress in her studies because she had been revising diligently.

6.stem_plain: All the information about the upcoming school workshops ________ to the students last week.

7.stem_plain: The commitment displayed by the students ________ the reason why they did well in the project.

8.stem_plain: The young boy helped the old lady ________ the busy road.

9.stem_plain: If John ________ early last night, he would not have missed his school bus this morning.

10.stem_plain: ________ his injury, the participant was unable to complete the race.

1.note: 句中的 's 是 has 的缩写（与过去分词 eaten 构成现在完成时），因此对应的反义疑问句应使用 hasn't he。
1.concept: 反义疑问句 — Tag Questions — present perfect tense
1.zh: “爸爸已经吃过午饭了，不是吗？”玛丽问。

2.note: be well-known for 为固定搭配，表示“因……而闻名/出名”，后面接具体的才能、特点或原因。
2.concept: 固定搭配 — Prepositions — be well-known for
2.zh: 拉妮因其在种植兰花方面的专业知识而闻名。

3.note: 在时间状语从句（如 when 引导的从句）中，通常用一般现在时（simple present）来表示将来发生的事情。
3.concept: 时态 — Tense — simple present in time clauses
3.zh: “当爱丽丝听到她将代表班级参加演讲比赛时，她不会很兴奋吗？”本问。

4.note: object to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接名词或动名词（doing），因此选择 buying。
4.concept: 动名词 — Gerunds — object to doing something
4.zh: 母亲反对给莎拉买那个包，因为太贵了。

5.note: progress（进步）是不可数名词，不能用 few 或 many 修饰；根据后半句“因为她一直在勤奋温习”可知是取得了“很大”的进步，故选 much。
5.concept: 量词与名词修饰 — Quantifiers — much vs little/few with uncountable nouns
5.zh: 蒂娜在学业上取得了很大进步，因为她一直在勤奋地温习。

6.note: 主语 information 是不可数名词，谓语动词形式用单数；结合时间状语 last week 可知这里应使用一般过去时的被动语态，故选 was given。
6.concept: 主谓一致与被动语态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Passive Voice
6.zh: 关于即将举行的学校工作坊的所有信息已于上周发给了学生。

7.note: 句子的核心主语是 The commitment（单数），“displayed by the students” 是过去分词短语作后置定语；根据后半句的过去时动词 did 可知整句话应用过去时态，谓语动词选 was。
7.concept: 主谓一致与时态 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Tense
7.zh: 学生们展现出的奉献精神是他们在项目中表现出色的原因。

8.note: help sb. (to) do sth. 为固定句型，表示“帮助某人做某事”，后接动词原形或不带 to 的不定式，故选择原形 cross。
8.concept: 非谓语动词 — Bare Infinitives — help someone do something
8.zh: 那个小男孩帮助老妇人穿过繁忙的马路。

9.note: 这是一个与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句（Third Conditional）。条件从句中表示对过去事实的虚拟，应该使用过去完成时（had + 过去分词），故选 had slept。
9.concept: 虚拟语气 — Conditional Sentences — Type 3 (Past Unreal Condition)
9.zh: 如果约翰昨晚早点睡，他今天早上就不会错过校车了。

10.note: 前半句的“他的伤势”与后半句的“未能完成比赛”之间是显而易见的因果关系。Due to 意为“由于、因为”，且后接名词短语，完全符合语境。
10.concept: 原因介词短语 — Prepositional Phrases — due to vs despite/although
10.zh: 由于受伤，该参赛者未能完成比赛。

11.stem_plain: The children were thrilled at the idea of going for a class learning journey. They felt ________ the entire day.

12.stem_plain: To prevent people from getting too close to the turtle's nest on the beach, the Nature Lovers' Society ________ the area.

13.stem_plain: The top student of the school ________ her success to her parents and teachers who had nurtured her in the formative years of her life.

14.stem_plain: The fight between Peter and Ming was ________ only because their teacher intervened.

15.stem_plain: Due to time constraints, the debate team members ensured that their argument was brief and to the point. They were very ________.

11.zh: 孩子们对去参加班级学习之旅的想法感到兴奋。他们整天都感到极其兴奋。
11.note: ‘exhilarated’指极其高兴、兴奋的，与前文的“thrilled（激动万分的）”语境完全契合。

choices.eg: She was deeply moved by the kind gestures of her neighbors.
He felt daunted by the huge amount of work left to do.

choices.zh: 极其兴奋的，欢欣鼓舞的
choices.eg: The runners felt exhilarated as they crossed the finish line.
Parents are naturally apprehensive about their children's safety.

12.zh: 为了防止人们太靠近海滩上的海龟巢，自然爱好者协会拉起警戒线隔离了该区域。
12.note: ‘cordoned off’是短语动词，指用警戒线、绳子等圈起来以阻止人们进入，常用于保护现场或特定区域。

choices.eg: The celebrity fended off questions from the reporters at the airport.
The workers marked off the boundary of the soccer field with white paint.
We rounded off the perfect evening with a delicious chocolate dessert.
The police cordoned off the street after the bank robbery.

13.zh: 学校的第一名学生将她的成功归功于在建构期抚育她的父母和老师。
13.note: ‘attributed’通常与 to 连用（attribute something to someone），意思是把……归功于……。

choices.eg: The teacher assigned a new project to the students today.
He attributed his good health to regular exercise and a balanced diet.

choices.zh: 把……联系起来 (通常与 with 连用)
choices.eg: Most people associate the spring season with flowers and sunshine.
She acknowledged her mistake and promised to fix it immediately.

14.zh: 彼得和明之间的打架得以避免，仅仅是因为他们的老师介入了。
14.note: ‘averted’意思是避免、防止（坏事的发生），与后文老师介入平息冲突的语境相符。

choices.eg: The driver swerved quickly and averted a terrible accident.
The acrobat inverted his body and stood on his hands easily.
Traffic was diverted to another road due to the construction.
After the computer rebooted, the settings reverted to default.

15.zh: 由于时间限制，辩论队的成员确保他们的论点简明扼要。他们说话非常简练。
15.note: ‘concise’意为简明的、简练的，直接对应前文中的“brief and to the point（简明扼要）”。

choices.eg: The scientist gave precise measurements for the laboratory experiment.
Please give me specific instructions on how to use this machine.
Your essay should be concise and not contain unnecessary words.
The weather forecast was accurate, and it rained just as predicted.

16.note: 近义词替换 — 加深/提高（理解）

choices.eg: The teacher tried to foster a love of reading in her students.
The artist used recycled materials to create a beautiful sculpture.
It takes time to cultivate good study habits.
Reading regularly can enhance your vocabulary skills.

17.note: 近义词替换 — 迷恋/惊奇感

choices.eg: To the delight of the children, the clown arrived at the party.
The boy looked at the starry night sky with a sense of wonder.
She was in ecstasy when she passed her driving test.
Children are often full of curiosity about the world around them.

18.note: 词汇理解 — 照亮（天空）

choices.eg: Beautiful paintings adorn the walls of the museum.
The morning sun started to brighten the dark bedroom.
The teacher used a yellow marker to highlight the keywords.
The blue dress served to accentuate the color of her eyes.

19.note: 近义词替换 — 虚弱的/衰弱的

choices.eg: The old dog gave a feeble bark when the visitor arrived.
The weary travelers finally reached their hotel after midnight.
He patted the kitten with a gentle touch.
She has long, slender fingers that are perfect for playing piano.

20.note: 上下文语境 — 启发/教育

choices.eg: The coach gave a speech to inspire the team before the game.
Museums help to educate the public about local history.
A good bonus structure can motivate employees to work harder.
The new dynamic toys help stimulate a child's imagination.

cloze: Last summer, Maya decided to embark on a journey that would forever broaden her perspective on life. She had always been curious about places far from her hometown, and this trip promised experiences that would [Q16 (deepen)] her understanding of different cultures.

On the first day, she visited a small village nestled among rolling hills. The locals welcomed her with radiant smiles. Maya felt a sense of [Q17 (fascination)] as she explored the winding streets, each corner revealing a new surprise.

In the evenings, she would sit by the river, watching the sunset that seemed to [Q18 (illuminate)] the sky with brilliant shades of orange and pink. These moments reminded her that life was not just about achievements, but also about the beauty that surrounded her.

One afternoon, while hiking a steep trail, Maya encountered an elderly man who was [Q19 (frail)] yet radiated a quiet wisdom. He shared inspirational stories of his youth, and Maya listened intently, knowing that these narratives would [Q20 (enlighten)] her in ways books never could. By the end of the trip, Maya felt transformed.
zh: 去年夏天，玛雅决定踏上一段将永远拓宽她人生视界的旅程。她一直对远离家乡的地方充满好奇，这次旅行承诺带来的体验将加深她对不同文化的理解。
第一天，她访问了一个依偎在连绵起伏的山丘之中的小村庄。当地人带着灿烂的笑容欢迎她。当玛雅探索弯弯曲曲的街道时，她感到一种着迷感，每个角落都展现出一个新的惊喜。
傍晚时分，她会坐在河边，看着夕阳似乎用橙色和粉红色的灿烂色彩照亮了天空。这些时刻提醒着她，生活不仅关乎成就，也关乎围绕在她身边的美丽。
一天下午，在攀登一条陡峭的山路时，玛雅遇到了一位身体虚弱却散发着沉静智慧的老人。他分享了自己年轻时励志的故事，玛雅专心地听着，知道这些故事会以书本永远无法做到的方式启发她。到旅行结束时，玛雅感觉自己焕然一新。

21.stem_plain: Which of the following is true about the launch?

options.1: Reservations for the shoes can be made online.
options.2: Only a limited number of shoes will be available.
options.3: Anyone can purchase the shoes on 12 December.
options.4: Falcon shoes will be sold at all Sports House outlets.

22.stem_plain: What kind of poster is shown in Text 1?

23.stem_plain: Linda often experiences pain in her foot and prefers to run at night. Based on the information in Text 1, which features of the shoes would be most important for her?

24.stem_plain: What is the main message of Text 2?

options.1: It is easy to choose a pair of running shoes.
options.2: Running shoes are for the young and old.
options.3: Proper running shoes makes one run faster.
options.4: Wearing the right pair of running shoes is important.

25.stem_plain: Both the descriptions for the shoes in Text 1 and the content of Text 2 ________.

options.2: offer tips on how to select running shoes
options.3: compare different features of running shoes
options.4: highlight the importance of quality running shoes

21.note: 海报中明确提到“Only 100 pairs!”（只有100双！），说明只有限量的鞋子可供购买。因此选择选项2。

22.note: 该海报宣传新鞋发布、标注价格、会员专属以及发售细节，主要目的是为了进行新品促销并吸引顾客购买。因此选择选项2。

23.note: 林达（Linda）喜欢“夜跑”（run at night），因此需要特性 D) Visibility（反光材料在低光下可见）；她“脚部常感到疼痛”（pain in her foot），因此需要特性 F) Support（提供稳定性以实现无受伤跑步）。因此选择选项3。

24.note: 文本2的第一句“Wearing the right shoes is important for every runner...”以及结尾“choosing the right pair of running shoes... is an important one”都开门见山并总结指出了选择和穿着合适跑鞋的重要性。因此选择选项4。

25.note: 文本1通过详细列举跑鞋的优质功能（轻量、缓震、支撑、可见性等）来强调其优良品质，文本2则深入阐述了好的跑鞋在保护身体和避免受伤方面的关键作用，两文共同强调了优质/合适跑鞋的重要性。因此选择选项4。
25.concept: 跨文本共同核心观点提炼

26.note: “when the diaphragm... suddenly contracts” 意为“当横隔膜突然收缩时”。由于27题开头大写，此处26题应填when引导时间状语从句，连接前后两个分句。

27.note: 此处是非限制性定语从句，先行词是单数名词“the diaphragm”，在从句中作主语，故用which。

28.note: “breathe in air” 意为“吸入空气”，与breathe构成固定动词短语搭配。

29.note: “the familiar 'hic' sound” 特指上文提到的打嗝时发出的熟悉的“hic”声，用定冠词the。

30.note: 修饰可数名词复数“reasons”，结合后文列举的各种原因，应填many，意为“有很多原因”。

31.note: “stop on its own” 为固定短语，意为“自行停止”，its指代单数名词hiccups的发生现象或个体打嗝动作，此处习惯上用单数its own。

32.note: “get rid of...” 为固定短语，意为“摆脱/消除……”。

33.note: 修饰复数名词“methods”，指代前面提到的憋气、喝水等这些方法，用these。

34.note: “go back to normal” 意为“恢复正常”，图片中学生也已写出to提示。

35.note: “although they can be annoying” 意为“尽管它们可能会让人感到烦人”，表转折/让步，图片中已有正确勾选提示。

cloze: Hiccups are sudden, repeated sounds that happen when your body makes a small "jump" inside your chest. They occur [Q26] the diaphragm, a muscle under the lungs,

[Q27] helps you breathe, suddenly contracts. This quick movement makes you breathe [Q28] air very fast. At the same time, the gap between your vocal cords snaps shut, causing [Q29] familiar "hic" sound.

There are [Q30] reasons why hiccups occur. You might eat or drink too quickly, swallow too much air or even laugh too hard. Sometimes, feeling nervous or excited can also make you get hiccups. In most cases, hiccups last only a few minutes and stop on [Q31] own.

To get rid [Q32] hiccups, people often try holding their breath, drinking water slowly or breathing into a paper bag. [Q33] methods help the diaphragm relax so that your breathing goes back [Q34] normal. Hiccups are harmless, [Q35] they can be annoying. The sounds are a normal part of how our bodies work.
zh: 打嗝是当你的身体在胸腔内部发生轻微“跳动”时，所产生的突然且重复的声音。当位于肺部下方的肌肉——横隔膜，
（横隔膜）帮助你呼吸，突然收缩时，打嗝就会发生。这种快速的运动会使你非常快地吸入空气。与此同时，你的声带之间的缝隙会突然关闭，从而发出那声令人熟悉的“嗝”声。
打嗝的发生有很多原因。你可能吃东西或喝东西太快，吞下了太多空气，甚至笑得太厉害。有时，感到紧张或兴奋也会让你打嗝。在大多数情况下，打嗝只会持续几分钟，然后就会自行停止。
为了摆脱打嗝，人们经常尝试憋气、慢慢喝水或向纸袋里呼气。这些方法可以帮助横隔膜放松，从而使你的呼吸恢复正常。打嗝是无害的，尽管它们可能会让人感到烦人。这种声音是我们身体运作的正常一部分。

36.note: 拼写错误，应将 occassion 纠正为正确的拼写 occasion（场合、时刻）。

37.note: 拼写错误，表示外表、容貌的名词 appearence 应纠正为 appearance。

38.note: 拼写错误，表示感到“尴尬的”形容词 embrassed 应纠正为 embarrassed。

39.note: 语境时间轴的先后顺序错误。根据 realized 动作可知，这里表达在她疯狂赶着出门的“那阵忙乱中”，表示在……期间应将动词过去式 wore 纠正为介词 in（或 during）。

40.note: 固定搭配错误，“在赶时间/匆忙中”应该用短语 in her frantic rush，划线词 on 错误，应改为 in。

41.note: 形容词 soft 应当改为副词形式 softly，用以修饰前面的轻声笑动词 chuckled。

42.note: 原句中名词 comfort 应当改为形容词形式 comforting，用以修饰后面的名词 hug，表示“令人宽慰的拥抱”。

43.note: 整篇故事都是用过去时态来讲述上周六发生的事情，动词 receives 应当改为过去式 received。

44.note: 拼写错误，形容词“精美的、优雅的”elegeant 应纠正为 elegant。

45.note: 拼写错误，形容词“方便的”convinient 应纠正为 convenient。

cloze: Last Saturday, my family gathered at a bustling seafood restaurant. It was a special [Q36(occassion)] as it was Grandma's eightieth birthday. My cousin, Sarah, who cared deeply about her [Q37(appearence)], arrived wearing a stunning silk dress that shimmered under the chandeliers. However, she soon felt [Q38(embrassed)] and her confidence vanished when she realised she had accidentally [Q39(wore)] one black sandal and one navy blue slipper [Q40(on)] her frantic rush to leave home. Everyone at the table chuckled [Q41(soft)] at the sight, but Grandma gave her a warm, [Q42(comfort)] hug to make her feel better.

During the lively party, Grandma [Q43(receives)] many wonderful gifts from her grandchildren, ranging from handmade cards to [Q44(elegeant)] jewellery. My brother gave her a brand-new tablet, explaining that it would be much more [Q45(convinient)] for her to video call us whenever she missed hearing our voices or seeing our faces. Grandma smiled brightly, her eyes twinkling with joy as she thanked us all for such a memorable day.
zh: 上周六，我们全家聚集在一家热闹的海鲜餐厅。这是一个特殊的日子，因为那天是祖母的八十岁生日。我的表姐莎拉非常在意自己的外表，她穿着一件在吊灯下闪闪发光的漂亮丝绸连衣裙来到了现场。然而，当她意识到自己在急急忙忙出门时，竟然错误地穿了一只黑色凉鞋和一只藏青色拖鞋后，她很快感到很尴尬，自信心也消失了。看到这一幕，桌上的每个人都轻声笑了起来，但祖母给了她一个温暖、舒适的拥抱，让她感觉好一点。
在热闹的派对上，祖母收到了孙子孙女们送来的许多精美礼物，从手工卡片到精雅的珠宝首饰。我哥哥送了她一台全新的平板电脑，并解释说，每当她想念我们的声音或看到我们的脸时，用它进行视频通话对她来说会方便得多。祖母灿烂地笑了，她的眼睛里闪烁着喜悦的光芒，感谢我们大家度过了这样一个难忘的一天。

46.note: through simple greetings 表示“通过简单的问候”来展现礼貌，也可用 by 或 with。

47.note: where everyone feels valued 意为“让每一个人都感到被重视”，符合营造友好环境的语境。

48.note: ensure safety, fairness, and order 意为“确保所有人的安全、公平和秩序”，也可用 maintain 或 promote。

49.concept: 动词名词化/分词作主语
49.note: waiting patiently for one's turn 意为“耐心轮候/排队”，此处用动名词短语 waiting 作举例说明的主语成分。

50.note: respect for others 为固定搭配，意为“对他人的尊重”，与前面的自律（self-discipline）并列。

51.note: how your actions can/may affect other people 意为你的行为“可能会”如何影响他人。

52.note: in group activities/work 意为在“小组活动”或“小组合作”中包容较内向的学生。

53.concept: 形容词词义辨析与对比
53.note: both personal and shared resources 意为“个人财产和公共/共享资源”，与 shared 形成呼应与对比，也可用 own。

54.note: with care 为固定短语，意为“小心地/爱惜地”使用学校公物。

55.note: strengthen existing bonds and maintain good relationships 连接两个并列的动词短语，表示“增强纽带并保持良好关系”。

56.note: handling disagreements when/as they arise 意为“当分歧出现时”去处理它们，体现了情感上的成熟。

57.note: in doubt 为固定搭配，意为“心存疑问/困惑”，when you are in doubt 意为当你对困难概念有疑问时。

58.note: being kind 与前面的 participating... 和后面的 helping... 构成形式一致的现在分词平行结构，作伴随或方式状语。

59.note: positive values/qualities/traits such as graciousness... 意为通过展示像和蔼、感激等“积极的价值观/品质”。

60.note: contribute to... 为固定搭配，意为“有助于/促成”更好的学校体验，主语为复数 students，故动词用原形。

cloze: Being a responsible member of the school community means more than just attending classes on time. It involves showing courtesy to teachers, classmates, and staff [Q46(through)] simple greetings, such as saying "please" and "thank you". These polite behaviours create a positive and friendly environment where [Q47(everyone)] feels valued.

Respecting school rules is another important part of being responsible. Rules are designed to [Q48(ensure)] safety, fairness, and order for all. For instance, [Q49(waiting)] patiently for one's turn, keeping noise levels low in the library, and following instructions in the classroom are ways to demonstrate self-discipline and [Q50(respect)] for others.

Think about how your actions [Q51(can)] possibly affect other people. Helping a classmate who has dropped her books, offering to share materials, or including quieter students in group [Q52(activities)] are all examples of thoughtfulness and kindness.

A responsible student also takes care of both [Q53(personal)] and shared resources. This includes returning borrowed books on time, keeping the canteen clean, and using school property [Q54(with)] care. Students must not forget to appreciate the efforts of those who maintain the school grounds.

Communication and cooperation are equally important. Listening attentively, speaking politely, and working well in teams help to strengthen existing bonds [Q55(and)] maintain good relationships with others. Handling disagreements [Q56(when)] they arise shows emotional maturity.

What about diligence? Is a diligent student a responsible one? Most certainly! Completing assignments on time, and asking questions when you are in [Q57(doubt)] about a difficult concept taught in class reflect a commitment to learning.

Finally, responsible students promote a positive school culture by participating in community activities, [Q58(being)] kind towards newcomers, and helping others in need. These actions will help make the school environment safe and conducive for all. By demonstrating positive [Q59(values)] such as graciousness and gratitude each day, students [Q60(contribute)] to a better school experience for both their peers and teachers. That way, everyone within the school community can flourish and find joy in shared everyday experiences.
zh: 作为学校社区中负责任的一员，其意义远不止按时上课。它包括通过简单的问候向老师、同学和教职员工展现礼貌，例如说“请”和“谢谢”。这些礼貌的行为创造了一个积极友好的环境，让每个人都感到被重视。
遵守校规是负责任的另一个重要部分。规则旨在确保所有人的安全、公平和秩序。例如，耐心排队轮候、在图书馆保持低噪音、以及在课堂上听从指示，都是展示自律和尊重他人的方式。
思考一下你的行为可能会如何影响他人。帮助掉了书的同学、主动分享材料、或者在小组活动中接纳较内向的学生，这些都是体贴和善良的榜样。
一个负责任的学生还会爱护个人资源和共享资源。这包括按时归还借来的书、保持食堂清洁以及爱惜地使用学校财产。学生们绝不能忘记感激那些维护校园场地人员的付出。
沟通与合作同样重要。倾听专注、说话礼貌以及团队合作融洽，有助于增强现有的纽带并与他人保持良好的关系。在分歧出现时加以妥善处理，展现了情感上的成熟。
那勤奋呢？勤奋的学生是负责任的学生吗？当然是！按时完成作业，并在对课堂上讲授的艰难概念心存疑问时提出问题，都反映了对学习的承诺。
最后，负责任的学生通过参与社区活动、友善对待新来者以及帮助有需要的人，来促进积极的校园文化。这些行动将有助于让学校环境对每个人来说都安全且有益。通过每天展示如和蔼和感激等积极的价值观，学生们有助于为同龄人和老师们带来更好的学校体验。这样一来，学校社区内的每个人都能够蓬勃发展，并在共同的日常体验中找到快乐。

61.concept: 词性转换 — 形容词变名词 (deep -> depth)
61.zh: 她知识的深度给我留下了深刻的印象。
61.note: 改写要点：将从句中的形容词 deep 转换为与其对应的名词形式 depth。整句调整为：I was impressed by the depth of her knowledge.
61.answer: I was impressed by the depth of her knowledge.

62.concept: 时间状语从句 — 连词 As soon as (一……就……) 的用法
62.zh: 电影一结束，我们立刻就离开了。
62.note: 改写要点：使用 As soon as 引导时间状语从句，原句中的 immediately 语意已包含其中，需在主句中省去。主从句动作时态保持一致（一般过去时）。
62.answer: As soon as the movie ended, we left.

63.concept: 平行结构与偏好表达 — would rather ... than ... 句型
63.zh: 戴维宁愿读书，也不喜欢玩电脑游戏。
63.note: 改写要点：would rather 后接动词原形（read），表示更愿意做的事情；其后通常搭配 than 连接不愿做的事情，且前后动词形式需保持平行（play）。
63.answer: David would rather read than play computer games.

64.concept: 间接引语 — 一般疑问句的转述与时态/时间状语转换
64.zh: 妈妈问萨拉她上周是否参加了科学测试。
64.note: 改写要点：1. 一般疑问句的间接引语由 if 或 whether 引导，语序调整为陈述句语序；2. 一般过去时（did sit）向后推一个时态变为过去完成时（had sat）；3. 人称代词与时间状语转换：you -> she, last week -> the previous week 或 the week before。
64.answer: Mother asked Sarah if she had sat for the Science test the previous week.

65.concept: 评价与行为的句型转换 — It is + 形容词 + of someone + to do something 结构
65.zh: 她真是太好了，在我缺席的时候帮我收集了工作纸。
65.note: 改写要点：将 "She is such a nice person" 句型转换为评价某人品质特征的固定被动/形式主语结构。nice 后面接介词 of 引出行为主体，再接动词不定式（to collect）：It was so nice of her to collect my worksheets for me when I was absent.
65.answer: It was so nice of her to collect my worksheets for me when I was absent.

paragraphs.1: 布莱恩猛地睁开眼睛。他感到一种难以置信、近乎疯狂的口渴。他的嘴里又干又臭，还黏糊糊的。他的嘴唇裂开了，看起来好像在流血。他的皮肤全都干瘪了。他真切地感受到了那种口渴，并且脸上火辣辣地疼。此时是午后。太阳已经移到了他的头顶，在他睡觉的时候把他晒得像被烤过一样。他的脸感觉像在着火，马上就要起水泡蜕皮了。
paragraphs.6: 他站了起来，用手拉着树把自己撑起来，因为身上依然有些疼痛并且十分僵硬，接着他朝下方的湖面看去。那是水，但他不知道自己能不能喝。他觉得喝湖里的水这个想法很糟糕，但湖水是蓝色的，看起来很干净，而他的嘴和喉咙正因极度口渴而火烧火燎。还会不会有别的可以饮用的水源？况且，当他从飞机里游出来并游到岸边时，他已经吞下了不少这种湖水。
paragraphs.12: 布莱恩在一场由飞机坠毁、额头严重淤青、身体酸痛以及折磨得他无法思考的口渴所构成的境遇中感到无能为力。他迈着小步顺着斜坡走向湖边。沿着湖岸边缘长满了茂密的刺草阻挡着去路，而且湖水看起来有些浑浊。他厌恶地皱起眉头，看着在水里游泳的小虫子，同时很高兴看到有一根木头从岸边向湖中延伸了大约十米，上面有坚固的树枝立着，就像强有力的把手一样。
paragraphs.18: 他在木头上面保持着平衡，用四肢支撑着自己，摇摇晃晃地越过杂草和泥泞的水域。当他来到湖水清澈、看不到小虫子游动的地方时，他跪在木头上准备喝水。他心想自己也许应该先尝一小口，脑子里还在对这湖水进行纠结。然而，当他用弯曲的手掌捧起水送向嘴边，感受到冰凉的湖水顺着他干裂的嘴唇流过舌尖时，他便再也无法停下来了。
paragraphs.24: 他以前从未这么渴过，哪怕是在夏天骑着自行车长途旅行时也是如此。他弯下腰，将嘴贴近湖面，不停地大口狂饮，深深地吸入并大口大口地吞咽着。他喝到肚子都胀了起来，甚至因为喝了太多水差一点从木头上滑落下去，接着他站起身，摇摇晃晃地走回岸边，随后立刻感到一阵恶心，把喝下去的大部分水都呕吐了出来。
paragraphs.29: 不过，到了那个时候，他的口渴感已经彻底消失了，湖水似乎还减轻了他头部的疼痛，尽管晒伤的脸在脸上依然感觉很热。他再次顺着岸边爬到那棵没有树枝的高大树下，重新坐下来，背靠着树干。现在天气很热。太阳升得很高，他坐在树荫下感受到了相对的舒适，但他知道，还有很多必须要做的事情在等着他。
